dropzones.name: Aeroporti i Batllavës
dropzones.status_evidence: A dated 24 January 2020 local report identifies former recurring civilian sport parachuting and says the airfield is inactive; no 2025+ reopening evidence was established. Re-checked 2026-11-14: The 24 January 2020 account explicitly describes former aircraft parachuting at Batllava/Dumosh and an inactive airfield used as grassland. Albanian-language follow-up searches did not establish 2025+ reopening or a current civilian jump operation, so the historical closure is not presented as a newly verified current status.

sources.what: Former sport/military airfield with frequent aircraft parachuting, now disused according to 2020 report.
Opened airport dataset; XK-0009 airfield coordinates.

dropzones.note: Historical place only; no current civilian dropzone confirmed in Kosovo.
